name: AmScope 40X-1000X Advanced Student Biological Microscope
description: This biological microscope has contemporary design and almost all the advanced features a microscope has: 3-D double layer mechanical stage, coaxial coarse & fine focusing, brightness-adjustable illumination system and so on. With 10X and 25X eyepieces, it offers five levels of magnification: 40X, 100X, 250X, 400X & 1000X. It is a wonderful instrument for students to learn sciences. It is also a perfect family or home school microscope.
